title: gifola filaginoides
intro: Gifola filaginoides, commonly known as Gifola, is a plant species within the family of mint plants. It is valued for its potential health benefits, particularly in the treatment of digestive issues and as an anti-inflammatory agent. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to soothe the digestive system and calm inflammation. Bioactive constituents of Gifola filaginoides include rosmarinic acid and other phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
